info.name: Insights.Api Balancing Mechanism Dynamic Market Index API
Market Index Data (MID) price time series

params.name: from
params.description: The "from" start time or settlement date for the filter.

params.name: to
params.description: The "to" start time or settlement date for the filter.

params.name: settlementPeriodFrom
params.description: The "from" settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: settlementPeriodTo
params.description: The "to" settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: dataProviders
params.description: The data providers to query. If no data provider is selected both will be displayed.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides Market Index Data received from NGESO.
            
Market Index Data is a key component in the calculation of System Buy Price and System Sell Price for each
Settlement Period. This data is received from each of the appointed Market Index Data Providers (MIDPs) and
reflects the price of wholesale electricity in Great Britain in the short term markets. The Market Index Data
which is received from each MIDP for each Settlement Period consists of a Market Index Volume and
